items.title: Trump says every adult American will get $5,000 if Republicans win midterms
items.description: Speaking at a party convention, the US president gave no details on how the plan would work or where the money would come from.

items.title: Watch: Is Trump's $5,000 election pledge legal?
items.description: The US president has said every American will get $5,000 (£3,700) if the Republican Party wins November's midterms.

items.title: Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump
items.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

items.title: Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry
items.description: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.

items.title: Royal family rift after popular TV news presenter chosen to succeed Ugandan king
items.description: King Oyo's family say he left a will naming his young son as heir to the Tooro kingdom.

items.title: At least 20 dead after fire on cargo ship in eastern China, state media report
items.description: President Xi Jinping has called for urgent search and rescue efforts.

items.title: Apple's new boss starts with big gamble on £1,999 first folding iPhone
items.description: Apple showed off at an event the first major design change to the iPhone in almost 20 years.

items.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
items.description: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

items.title: Muted US response to UK's West Bank sanctions may reflect simmering frustration
items.description: The UK accuses Israel's government of turning a blind eye to the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians by settlers.

items.title: Tate brothers to remain in US jail as they fight extradition to UK
items.description: A federal judge denied them bail, saying the dual US-UK citizens' wealth and frequent international travel "constitute quintessential flight risks".

items.title: Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief
items.description: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.

items.title: Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway
items.description: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.
